description: Browse purchasable faith-content products on SoapBox (currently consented sermons; reading-plan and devotional bundles coming). Returns products with id, title, church, and price. Then pay for one with pay_with_x402 (USDC on Base). Optional church_id and text filter. No key required.

church_id.description: Optional SoapBox community id to scope the catalog to a single church.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter matched against product titles.

name: browse_catalog
